company.name: ICICI Bank
company.summary: A diversified bank serving individuals and businesses through branches and digital channels.
company.description: ICICI Bank provides deposits, payments, loans, cards, corporate banking and other financial services. It also has interests in financial-services businesses through subsidiaries and group relationships.
products: Loans against property, securities and investments
Mutual funds, bonds and government schemes
company.money: The bank earns interest on loans and investments and pays interest on deposits and other funding. Fees add revenue, while credit losses and operating costs reduce profit.
company.ownership: This profile covers ICICI Bank Limited. ICICI-branded insurance, securities and asset-management businesses can be separate legal entities or subsidiaries, so their ownership and reporting treatment must be checked.
watch: How much net interest is earned relative to assets?
Are borrowers repaying, and how much has the bank provided for possible losses?
Can deposits fund lending at a sustainable cost?
risks: Borrowers may not repay as expected.
Competition for deposits can raise funding costs.
Controls, technology and compliance failures can damage the bank and its customers.
update: Separate the bank from the wider group
The official company page lists several related financial businesses. Their familiar ICICI name does not make them the same listed entity.
company.question: Are customer deposits revenue for ICICI Bank?
company.answer: No. Deposits are funding the bank owes customers. Interest income and fees are revenue, while interest paid and credit losses are important costs.
company.productNote: Major official brand, product and business-offering families reviewed in October 2026. This groups variants, pack sizes, models, formulations or service subtypes where listing each one would obscure the company overview.
